frequency_question: What proportion of emergency redistricting challenges reaching state supreme courts are fully adjudicated with a final ruling within 18 days or less of a statutory ballot lock date?
membership_rule: Includes any state supreme court case involving a contested legislative or congressional map where an expedited petition for review was filed and a ruling was required within an 18-day window to impact ballot preparation. Excludes federal court proceedings and cases with no statutory time constraint.
